items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: Preservation Hall band there once, actually, well, with Jim Robinson and Percy Humphries... I knew the Preservation Hall people. I knew all of them.

ctx.x: Yeah. Uh, when did you go to Atlanta? 1962. 1962. Did you hear any New Orleans musicians over there?

Preservation Hall band there once, actually, well, with Jim Robinson and Percy Humphries, particularly, which must have been about 1970, 69 or 70, uh, after the Atlanta Jazz Club started, about 70, uh, some musicians came by. Doc Evans was there once.
